projectDescription: An MCP server that aggregates crypto and blockchain APIs, letting you query live market data, on-chain analytics, wallet balances, and more through a single interface.
keyFeatures: Live cryptocurrency price and market data via MCP tools
On-chain analytics including transactions, blocks, and gas fees
Wallet balance lookups across multiple blockchains
DeFi protocol data — liquidity pools, yields, and swaps
Simple API key configuration for multiple data providers
Compatible with any MCP-aware AI client (Claude, Cursor, etc.)
publicApiSurface: get_price — fetch current price for one or more tokens
get_market_data — 24h volume, market cap, price change
get_wallet_balance — native and token balances for an address
get_transaction — look up a transaction by hash
get_block — retrieve block details by number or hash
get_gas — current gas price / fee estimates
get_defi_pool — liquidity pool stats for a given pair
get_news — latest headlines for a coin or keyword
list_tokens — search tokens by symbol or name
